curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach what each curb color allows, then which lane to use on a long one-way street.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each curb color and lane rule; contrast cards for the three curbs and the center lane.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions that match a curb color to what it allows.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain broken, solid and double solid white lines and when each may be crossed.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each white line; contrast cards for crossable versus uncrossable lines.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about crossing white lines.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach what yellow lane lines divide, the left-edge yellow line, and how reversible lanes work.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for white versus yellow lines and edges.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about yellow lines and reversible lanes.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the rules for every turn, then right turns and right on red.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about turning safely and turning right on red.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through the left-turn path for each combination of two-way and one-way roads and the one left turn allowed on red.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each left-turn rule; contrast cards for starting lanes, ending lanes and turns on red.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about lane positions for left turns.
